job_desc:
I need a complete Shopify store built from the ground up to sell a line of physical products. The project starts with crafting a fully custom theme that reflects my brand's personality and delivers a smooth shopping experience on desktop and mobile.

Beyond the visual design, I also want the store configured with:
• Customer reviews displayed on each product page and summarized site-wide
• A secure payment gateway set up and tested (Shopify Payments plus one additional method, phonepay , Razorpay etc)
• Inventory management configured so stock levels sync automatically and low-stock alerts fire without fail

I will supply product photos, copy, and brand guidelines. You'll handle theme design, layout, app selection or custom code (if needed) for the three features above, and launch-ready testing. Please outline your approach, timeline, and any past Shopify builds that show similar custom work.

requirements.description: Craft a fully custom Shopify theme for desktop and mobile responsiveness.
Configure customer reviews displayed on product pages and summarized site-wide.
Set up and test a secure payment gateway integration.
Configure inventory management with automatic sync and low-stock alerts.

job_data.core_problem: Launching a complete custom Shopify store with automated inventory sync, reviews, and secure multi-gateway payments.

proposals.proposal: Hi, I am an expert Shopify developer and I can build your store from scratch. I will design a fully custom responsive theme tailored for both desktop and mobile layouts to guarantee a smooth UX. However, please note that my current scope and quote will only cover the theme customization and front-end layout development. I will not handle the app setups for site-wide reviews, payment gateway integrations, or automated inventory sync systems in this milestone. You can check examples of my past work here: https://www.solawave.co/ (Solawave e-commerce Shopify storefront customization), https://basedbodyworks.com/ (Based Bodyworks Shopify store with inventory management), and https://coreve.in/ (Coreve custom Shopify store implementation).

true_projects.project_overview: Based Bodyworks Shopify store with inventory management.
